hooks.name: player_toggle_sneak
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerToggleSneakEvent)

doc_summary: A guest's player input changed sneaking: `native_player_toggle_sneak(player, name, sneaking)` is called after the hub applies the new state, only when it changes. The guest's state is swapped in. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_toggle_sneak@.
